originalGameRule.evidence: README.md identifies src/data/games.json as the source of truth for the 26 original games; records must also be Live, include the originals platform marker and use local GR8 artwork.
originalGameRule.notes: This is repository provenance, not a third-party licence. Owner should reconfirm promotional ownership before Pinterest activation.

partnerGameRule.source: No promotional-rights grant recorded in the repository
partnerGameRule.evidence: Playable embed permission is not treated as permission to republish partner artwork or gameplay.
partnerGameRule.notes: All GamePix and GameMonetize titles fail closed until explicit distribution rights are recorded.

collectionRule.source: GR8 GAMZ first-party brand and editorial collection routes
collectionRule.evidence: Creatives use only GR8 brand artwork, typography and factual collection descriptions; no partner artwork is used.
collectionRule.notes: Collection creatives must remain brand-only unless a separate artwork grant is added.
